escenas.texto: This week in Asia, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over six hundred and eighty-seven million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Asia edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Asia. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. At number ten, from India, Story & Spice, with a video posted six days ago. Over nineteen million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: two out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.
Next up, number nine, from India, KNOWLEDGE TV , with a video posted five days ago. Over nineteen million views. It also has over one thousand comments.

At number eight, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with a video posted five days ago. Over twenty million views. A video over thirty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over twenty-five thousand comments.
At number seven, from India, Do Maa Beti, with a video posted six days ago. Over twenty-one million views. A Short of just fifty-nine seconds. It also has one hundred and eighty-one comments.

In position number six, from India, Makeup by Parul Garg, with “Jab Tak Jeeyenge Karwachauth 2026 - Parul Garg”. Over twenty-four million views. A Short of just thirty-two seconds. It also has nine hundred and seventy-seven comments.
In position number five, from India, Shreemani Tripathi, with “Diwali safai went wrong!”. Over twenty-seven million views. It also has over two thousand comments.
At number four, from India, Maddock Films, with a video posted four days ago. Over twenty-nine million views. It also has over twenty-three thousand comments.
Bronze medal, from India, Shivangi the nayi bahu, with a video posted five days ago. Over forty-three million views. A Short of just thirty-three seconds. It also has over one thousand comments.

Silver medal, from India, Olive soul, with a video posted six days ago. Over forty-six million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and ten thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifty-four seconds.

And finally, number one most viewed, from India, Rimpi’s craft, with “DIY Diya Stand”. Over seventy-eight million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about eight hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-six seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Next up, number ten, from India, Shivang Mini, with a video posted one day ago. Over nine thousand comments. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.
In position number nine, from South Korea, 교양 Voyage, with a video posted six days ago. Over eleven thousand comments. It also has over five point nine million views.
Number eight, from India, Desi Gamers, with “Playing Free Fire INDIA For The First Time कय नय ह ?”. Over fourteen thousand comments. It also has over two million views.
Coming in at number seven, Adam Hidayat, with a video posted two days ago. Over seventeen thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over nine million views.
In position number six, from South Korea, RESCENE, with a video posted one day ago. Over eighteen thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over five point six million views.

In position number five, from South Korea, TREASURE (트레저), with a video posted one day ago. Over twenty-two thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about three hundred and seventy thousand views per hour. It got there in just one day.
Next up, number four, from Indonesia, Dhot Design, with a video posted four days ago. Over twenty-two thousand comments. It also has over nine point one million views.
Bronze medal, from India, Maddock Films, with a video posted four days ago. Over twenty-three thousand comments. It also has over twenty-nine million views.

Silver medal, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with a video posted five days ago. Over twenty-five thousand comments. A video over thirty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over twenty million views.

And here it is. Number one most commented, from India, SATVIK, with a video posted four days ago. Over forty-one thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty-nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Next up, number ten, from India, विरासत का चूल्हा 🤤, with a video posted four days ago. Over three hundred and twenty-nine thousand likes. It also has over fifteen million views.

Number nine, from Indonesia, Bertjerita, with a video posted five days ago. Over three hundred and forty-seven thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-six seconds. It also has over twelve million views.

At number eight, from India, Shivangi the nayi bahu, with a video posted five days ago. Over three hundred and seventy-eight thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-three seconds. It also has over forty-three million views.
Coming in at number seven, from India, Shreemani Tripathi, with “Diwali safai went wrong!”. Over three hundred and ninety-five thousand likes. It also has over twenty-seven million views.

Coming in at number six, from India, Story & Spice, with a video posted six days ago. Over three hundred and ninety-five thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over nineteen million views.

Number five, from Indonesia, Nadia Omara, with a video posted five days ago. Over three hundred and ninety-eight thousand likes. A video over thirty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over twenty million views.

In position number four, from Singapore, Lil Resumen, with a video posted six days ago. Over four hundred and twenty-two thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-seven seconds. It also has over thirteen million views.

Bronze medal, from India, Aman exe, with a video posted six days ago. Over four hundred and sixty-three thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and eighty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.
Silver medal, from India, Professor Of How, with a video posted six days ago. Over five hundred and twelve thousand likes. It also has over fourteen million views.

And here it is. Number one most liked, from India, Rimpi’s craft, with “DIY Diya Stand”. Over five hundred and forty-two thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about eight hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. A Short of just twenty-six seconds.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Africa. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Asia every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
